headline: As of 2026-10-30: 47,752,987 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+9.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 47,752,987 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+9.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (6,674,427), California (4,780,401), Florida (4,404,945).
